I use the Tcl/Tk interface to create widgets. It is quite useful, for
instance to select a record within a list, to enter and change the
parameters, etc... However, I have some limitations because I did not
find any detailled description of the Tcl command and their particular
syntax in R, only lists of commands, so I can not go as far as I want in
the manipulation of the widgets. May be are you aware of a site were I
could find a simple tutorial, or examples, to go further ?

Best wishes,

Michel

messages.author: 08f3062efe0fd1ca
messages.subject: Re: [Rkoholiki] Tcl/Tk
parts:
Tcl/tk is an "old" GUI builder tool. There's a lot of non specific information on the internet (see http://www.tkdocs.com/, this link is also in ?tcltk). A quick search brings up some R examples that may be of some value:

http://bioinf.wehi.edu.au/~wettenhall/RTclTkExamples/ (identical site @ http://www.sciviews.org/_rgui/tcltk/index.html)

HTH,
Roman
